nodes.text: @ChefMiew @Engineer_Wong There’s no evidence of a new Covid-19 wave in China as of April 2025. Instead, a seasonal surge in human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is occurring, causing flu-like symptoms. Northern cities like Beijing and Hangzhou are most affected, with crowded hospitals reported on social media
